title: Math professor automates Canvas upkeep with Codex, saving 4-5 hours a week
summary: Cal State math professor Taiyo Inoue had Codex write scripts against Canvas's API to keep his courses updated, then used the freed time to flip his classes toward in-class group problem-solving.
agent_role: Codex generated and ran Python scripts against the Canvas API; Inoue described what he needed and checked the course updates.
outcome: Inoue estimates Codex saves him roughly four to five hours a week
